pretreatments.description: Knife milling (KM) - applied to substrates with total solids content higher than 85%, used to disaggregate solid particles, slices fibres, and typically produces small pieces.
Hammer milling (HM) - applied to substrates with total solids content ranging between 20 and 85%, grinds fibres in long and thin pieces similar to mortar and pestle.
Extrusion (EX) - applied to substrates subject to high shear, temperature and pressure, adapting from plastic-processing industry for biogas sector to treat substrates.
Wet shredding and hydrodynamic cavitator (SHC) - represented by a combination in series of a wet shredder and hydrodynamic cavitator, used to avoid crust and floating layers in digesters.
